narr: Warm temperatures and rainfall resulted in an ice jam on Penns Creek in the Millmont area of Union County.
ev: An ice jam on Penns Creek led to the rescue of several people Friday morning in the Millmont area of Union County. No injuries were reported after two people and a dog were rescued from a house surrounded by water of Penns Creek.||According to the Mifflinburg Hose Company Facebook page, crews were called to the 900 block of Canada Drive in Lewis Township, Union County just after 5:30 a.m. Friday.
